component: Account discovery result and error precedence

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: parallelAutoDiscovery waits for the priority search and Exchange discovery to settle. If the priority search succeeds, it returns that config despite an Exchange error, appending a successful Exchange alternative only when needed. When priority discovery fails, an Exchange rejection is thrown only if it has a user-facing Fluent title; other rejected outcomes return null. External abort and the earlier redirect-cancellation branch are separate paths. This is the inspected result-selection contract, not proof that every provider or password-prompt flow works.
title: A successful priority account configuration wins over an Exchange discovery error
